title: The music follows the climb
notes: Height lifts the music out of the fog: distant at the foot of the tower, fully open by the summit.
The Dark brings a heartbeat: within four floors a slow lub-dub under the music; at two it races. Gone the moment you drive it back.
A streak brings a shimmer: from three perfects a soft high arpeggio in the piece's own key, brightening with every perfect.
